name: Free Community Cooling Hub Funding Proposal PowerPoint Template
description: An editable funding proposal for a community cooling hub, with need, service design, evidence, budget logic, delivery gates, and approval request.
longDescription: This original eight-slide community cooling hub funding proposal helps a team explain a local service idea to prospective funders. It moves from the need and intended outcome through a service model, illustrative evidence, funding structure, staged delivery, safeguards, and the specific decision requested. Deep indigo, pale sky, vivid coral, and editable native PowerPoint shapes form an original typographic system. Every example metric is illustrative and must be replaced with verified local evidence before presentation.
cover: A decision-ready plan for a welcoming neighborhood cooling hub.

story.title: A hot day can become an access problem
story.body: Describe who needs a safe indoor place and where existing options leave a gap.
points: Verify local needs before making claims

story.title: Define the service people should receive
story.body: Specify a usable space, clear hours, trained hosts, and a practical referral route.
points: Make the location easy to find

story.title: Show the decision, then the assumptions
story.body: Use local listening and a small pilot to test whether the proposed service is needed.
points: Replace every sample figure with records

story.title: Fund the service, not just the room
story.body: Separate setup, daily operations, and a reserve so the request has clear boundaries.

story.title: Open through three evidence gates
story.body: Confirm the site, run a limited pilot, and review outcomes before extending hours.

story.title: Plan for the people at the margins
story.body: Review accessibility, privacy, transport, staffing, and capacity before launch.

story.title: Approve a bounded pilot and review date
story.body: Ask for a named sponsor, a limited funding envelope, and an evidence review.
